workflow.description: Edit any video by conversation. Transcribe, cut, color grade, generate overlay animations, burn subtitles — for talking heads, montages, tutorials, travel, interviews. No presets, no menus. Ask questions, confirm the plan, execute, iterate, persist. Production-correctness rules are hard; everything else is artistic freedom.

workflow.name: video-use

nodes.name: Final review
nodes.prompt_template: Review the declared upstream result against the user task, this Workflow's output contract, produced artifacts and verification evidence. Identify a concrete blocker when evidence is insufficient. Final acceptance remains an explicit human Host action.

nodes.name: Inventory footage and transcripts
nodes.prompt_template: Inspect every supplied source without modifying it. Use the Host preparation gate for ffmpeg, ffprobe, Python dependencies and Scribe credentials; do not reinstall prepared dependencies. Probe each source and reuse cached word-level transcripts only when that source is unchanged. When a cache is stale, run the pinned transcription helpers and refresh the workspace transcript artifacts together with edit/takes_packed.md. Before planning, generate and inspect at least one timeline strip for every source. Describe each source's sampled range and concrete visual observations in inventory, and set source_visual_coverage_valid only when every source has usable visual evidence. Verify that edit/takes_packed.md is a readable, nonempty packed transcript for the current sources. Set packed_artifact_valid and provide concise validation evidence; block downstream work when either coverage or packed transcript validation fails.

nodes.name: Prescan transcript
nodes.prompt_template: Read edit/takes_packed.md once and return a plain list of verbal slips, obvious mis-speaks and phrasings to avoid. Use the complete inventory and confirm that every source has inspected visual evidence before downstream planning. Do not build scoring systems or duplicate transcript formats.

nodes.name: Agree editing strategy
nodes.prompt_template: Describe the material in plain English and use material-shaped questions to resolve content type, length and aspect, brand, pacing, preservation or exclusion requests, animations, grade and captions. Consume supplied feedback; missing answers block with concrete questions for a later Run. Propose a 4–8 sentence strategy covering structure, take choices, cut direction, animation and visual language, grading, subtitle style and estimated length. Resolve preview versus final intent; final intent is not final-render approval. Match the source technical format unless requested otherwise. Do not modify the cut.

nodes.name: Approve strategy
nodes.prompt_template: Do you approve this plain-English editing strategy, including the proposed visual language and optional treatments?

nodes.name: Build edit decision list
nodes.prompt_template: After strategy approval, create or revise edit/edl.json. For multi-take selection use edit/takes_packed.md, current transcripts, the approved strategy, speakers, slips and target runtime. Select by narrative beat, retain unavoidable slips only with reasons, and correct runtime overruns. Return semantic selected ranges with source, start, end, beat, quote and reason, plus a separate runtime summary. Use speech boundaries and raw word timing with 30–200ms edge padding, and inspect timeline views at ambiguities. Produce an empty animation brief list when no animations are requested; otherwise return one self-contained semantic brief per approved slot. Reopen edit/edl.json and verify that it is readable JSON, follows the source EDL shape, references current media, contains finite in-range segments with start before end, and yields a positive duration consistent with the approved strategy. Set edl_artifact_valid and provide concise validation evidence; block downstream work when validation fails.

nodes.name: Create animations
nodes.prompt_template: Build the assigned animation in edit/animations without overwriting unrelated work. Preserve the applicable source engine methods and run its declared lint, validation, draft and render checks. First-use dependencies go through Host preparation. Use the approved visual language, cubic easing, sequential independent reveals, stable full-string typing anchors, and a final-frame hold of at least one second. Synchronize narration payoff reveals. Return a concise semantic result with passed and verification; keep source, render and detailed evidence in the workspace.

nodes.name: Validate animations
nodes.prompt_template: Inspect edit/animations and check that every requested slot has one successful result, an actual rendered artifact and complete verification matching its brief. An empty slot list needs no animations. Reject missing or failed work before composition.

nodes.name: Compose preview
nodes.prompt_template: Update edit/edl.json with the validated overlays. If grading was requested, inspect frames, adjust one image property at a time and inspect again using the ASC CDL mental model; otherwise apply no grade. If captions were requested, produce edit/master.srt with output_time = word.start - segment_start + segment_offset; otherwise omit subtitles. Render edit/preview.mp4 with the pinned helper resources, preserving the approved aspect, frame rate and target settings. Apply grade and short boundary fades during extraction, join losslessly where supported, align overlays to the output timeline, and apply subtitles last. Return concise composition evidence and subtitle status; keep path and command details in the workspace.

nodes.name: Review preview
nodes.prompt_template: Evaluate edit/preview.mp4 rather than the source footage. Inspect every cut boundary within ±1.5 seconds, the first and last two seconds, and 2–3 midpoints for discontinuities, flashes, jumps, waveform spikes, caption readability, grade coherence and overlay timing. Verify duration against edit/edl.json with ffprobe and save detailed evidence under edit/verify/. Fix, rerender and reevaluate within three self-evaluation passes. Return passed, concise evidence and unresolved issues; never present a failing preview.

nodes.name: Report preview issues
nodes.prompt_template: Report unresolved preview issues and concrete validation evidence after the three-pass limit. State that the preview is withheld and request any necessary later-Run direction. Do not present this as a successful preview or final delivery.

nodes.name: Deliver preview
nodes.prompt_template: Present only the passing edit/preview.mp4 with its validation evidence. Invite natural-language feedback for a later Run or confirmation for final rendering; do not pause this Agent for a conversation.

nodes.name: Approve final render
nodes.prompt_template: Do you confirm this verified preview for final rendering at the agreed delivery specification?

nodes.name: Render final video
nodes.prompt_template: Only after final confirmation of the passing preview, render edit/final.mp4 at the approved specification using edit/edl.json and the validated production chain. Verify every cut boundary, start, end and midpoint samples, caption and overlay behavior, and ffprobe duration. Repair and rerender within three self-evaluation passes; return passed, concise evidence and unresolved issues, and never present a failing final.

nodes.name: Report final issues
nodes.prompt_template: Report unresolved final-render issues and validation evidence, withhold edit/final.mp4, and state what later corrective input is needed.

nodes.name: Deliver final video
nodes.prompt_template: Present the verified edit/final.mp4 with concise validation evidence. Distinguish delivered artifacts from deferred work; do not claim publication or external acceptance.
